## #1 — Spyder — 2008-07-20
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/3342/post-23665>

Alignment and Center combined...

1st

I was looking for a way to line up objects precisely by snapping their edges.  I came across a great script called Alignment written by Todd Rogers that did some great alignment operations and added some additional operations.

2nd

Whenever I imported children or did some weird operation the pivot/axis point would always become off center.  Martin is doing some great changes for version 5 and this may be covered; but in the meantime I have added the functionality to this tool because the Alignment methods made this simple to include.

3rd

If anyone is interested in having the pivot/axis moveable to the -x, +x, etc. side let me know and I could make some quick additional changes.

Lastly, place this in your /scripts/Tool/ directory and let me know if you have any difficulties and I will try and help out.

Thanks,
David

Attachments: [Alignment.js.zip](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/5264/)
